description: Reviewed import decisions for Cameroonian health facilities. Ten per-region passes plus a national reconciliation classified all 2083 OSM health features. Excluded features are not errors — they are morgues, a stadium, veterinary practices, NGO offices, a pharmacy recorded as burnt down, unnamed building polygons, and 61 duplicate clusters only a cross-region pass could see.
